title: tiles/basemap/tilejson.json
description: TileJSON-style index of the XYZ basemap tiles (F17; HiRISE colour ortho). Tile URLs are relative to the data root; the app prefixes its data base URL. Mars lon/lat go straight through the XYZ (Web Mercator tile) scheme (SPEC §4.2, D4). Written by make web from WS1's tiles (tools/make_web.py). Added in v1.1.0.
x-source: SPEC §4, §2.2 F17; brief WS1 (basemap tiles); WS5 STATUS (BasemapSource)

tiles.description: URL templates relative to the data root, e.g. tiles/basemap/{z}/{x}/{y}.webp

bounds.description: [w, s, e, n] lon/lat deg covered by the tiles at minzoom..maxzoom

zoom_bounds.description: optional: zoom level (string) -> [w, s, e, n] actually tiled at that zoom, where it is smaller than bounds (e.g. z17-18 over the focus area only)

tile_count.description: optional: zoom level (string) -> number of tiles
